spec.situation_desc: had their savings interest rate cut without noticing any letter

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Hannah speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hello. I’ve just noticed the interest rate on my savings account has been cut. I never saw a letter about it, and frankly I’m fed up with the bank changing things without making it clear.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has been frustrating, Declan. I can look into the rate and the notification. Before I discuss the account, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I can see the rate changed from 3.2% to 2.6% on your Thistle Easy Saver on 2 September.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s a big drop. I’ve checked the post and my emails, and there’s nothing from you. It’s really poor service.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re annoyed, and I’m sorry you’ve had to chase this. I’ll check what notification was sent and where it went.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Can you tell me why I wasn’t told?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t see a clear reason on the account notes, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll ask our savings team to review the notification record.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Someone will be in touch with you once they’ve looked into it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: When will you get back to me?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send the request to the savings team today, and I’ll personally call you by Friday afternoon with an update, even if they haven’t finished their review.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I just want a proper explanation of how this was missed.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course, Declan. I’ll make sure the request asks them to check both the rate change and the notification, and I’ll call you by Friday.
